First pre-release of 2.3 — **edit several books at once**.

## New

- **Several books in the Metadata area**: select books with Ctrl+click or Shift+click (or in the library, then right-click > *Edit metadata of n books*). The form shows what they share and *(various)* where they differ. Only the fields you type into change; authors, tags and list fields can *replace*, *add* or *remove* values. *Apply* shows a preview of every change first; *Save* writes the books with a backup as usual.
- **Several books ▾** in the toolbar: *Number series …* (start and step, in the order of the list), *Search and replace …* in one field (plain text or regular expression), *Author sort from authors*.
- **Published**: new field for the publication date (the book's `dc:date`, where Calibre and KOReader read it), also as a library column, in the Calibre comparison and in the Calibre import. Can be switched off under *Settings > Books > Metadata and Calibre*.
- In the library, *Remove advert text* works on all selected books.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.3-beta1.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
